settings.html: Digital Artist Ho Chi Minh City

content.value: I’m a digital artist focused on 3D visuals, AI-generated images and VFX. I collaborate with brands, agencies and production teams to create campaign-ready visuals, cinematic key visuals and experimental AI-assisted imagery.
Based in Ho Chi Minh City, I work across the full visual pipeline — from concept and art direction through to production-finished assets ready for print, digital and broadcast.

settings.html:
• Focus3D product visuals, AI-generated art, CGI key visuals, campaign image systems and VFX finishing.
  • ClientsBrands, agencies, production teams and campaign creators needing high-impact visuals.
  • ApproachBlend art direction, generative workflows, compositing and production sensibility into finished assets.
  • OutputKey visuals, product renders, pitch frames, social campaign assets, launch imagery and moving-image look development.

content.value: Creative services shaped around campaign delivery.
Each project is approached from concept through to production-ready delivery — visual-first, always.
Product-centric 3D scenes and stylized campaign worlds.
AI image workflows refined into premium, brand-safe visual directions.
Cinematic polish, retouching and post-production integration.
Hero images, visual systems and adaptations for brand campaigns.
For project inquiries, include objective, timeline, references, deliverables and usage channel.
